import { Tabs, TabItem } from '@site/src/components';

export const languages = ['Node.js', 'Python', 'Go'];

<Tabs defaultValue="node">
  <TabItem value="node" label="Node.js">
Install the package with `npm install client` and require it in your script.

```js
const client = require('client');
client.start();
```
  </TabItem>
  <TabItem value="python" label="Python">
Install the package with `pip install client` and import it in your module.

```python
import client
client.start()
```
  </TabItem>
  <TabItem value="go" label="Go">
Install the package with `go get example.com/client` and import it.

```go
import "example.com/client"

func main() { client.Start() }
```
  </TabItem>
</Tabs>

Each snippet uses the same protocol and returns `{ok: true}` on success.
